title: pyrrosia novoguineae
intro: Pyrrosia novoguineae, commonly known as the New Guinea shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is traditionally used in medicine due to its health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal issues. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which are derived from its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Pyrrosia novoguineae have been found to possess antioxidant and free radical scavenging activities, contributing to its potential therapeutic applications.
